`No demo` counts a prop on the component that declares it. A mode shared by 30
components is one idea, so the three tier-A rows split it: demonstrated once,
left on purpose, or genuinely missing. Only the last is a gap.

## One name, two meanings

A prop name that tiers differently on different components, because the
declared types genuinely differ. Not a generator fault — an ADR 002-shaped
observation about the vocabulary, recorded rather than smoothed over.

- size: A on Accordion, C on Drawer
- size: A on Accordion, C on CircularLoader
- size: A on Accordion, C on PulseLoader
- format: C on AvatarGroupCount, A on TimePicker
- type: C on Accordion, A on Toast

## Tier-A gaps

A whole mode with no demo anywhere and no reason recorded.

**None.** Every tier-A prop is demonstrated on its own component, demonstrated
once for the library, or left with a reason below.

## Demonstrated once, for the library

One demo per concept, not one per component. Each location is asserted: a prop
listed here with no demo anywhere fails the generator.

| Prop | Components | Where the one demo is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `unstyled` | 30 | StylingDemo — live side-by-side against the styled render |
| `asChild` | 9 | StylingDemo — `<Button asChild><a/></Button>`, a real anchor beside a button |
| `portalContainer` | 8 | StylingDemo — two identical dropdowns, one portalled into the box beside it |
| `keepMounted` | 4 | AnimationDemo — two dropdowns, one kept, counting `[role=listbox]` nodes |

## Left undemonstrated, with the reason

| Prop | Components | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reduceMotion` | 14 | A demo of it is a page that does not move. The behaviour is gated instead — `reduced-motion.contract` requires motion to EXIST when the preference is unset before requiring it to stop, which a screenshot could not show. |
| `variant` | 2 | Demonstrated on the parents. AccordionShimmer and AvatarBadge take the variant their parent is already showing; a second demo would restate the parent's. |
| `size` | 2 | A visible scale, demonstrated on the components that own it. AvatarGroupCount and RadioButton inherit the same scale their parents demo. |
| `shape` | 1 | As `size`: AvatarGroupCount follows the Avatar shape already on the page. |
| `dropdownPosition` | 1 | Demonstrated on Dropdown, Pagination and SearchableDropdown. CascadingDropdown's is the same prop with the same three values. |
| `type` | 1 | Toast has no JSX form — `useToast().show({ variant })` is the public surface and is demonstrated. `type` is the internal discriminant of the same idea. |
